Manchester United Held to Goalless Draw by Everton in Women's Super League

01 Nov 2026, 10:42 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysManchester United missed an opportunity to close the gap on the Women's Super League top three following a goalless draw against Everton. The match, which featured limited attacking fluency from both sides, left United unable to break down a well-organized Everton defense.

Image: https://www.theguardian.com/profile/tom-garry · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9 for the website

In this article
  1. Match Overview
  2. Manager Reaction
  3. Practical Implications

Manchester United missed an opportunity to close the gap on the Women's Super League top three following a goalless draw against Everton. The match, which featured limited attacking fluency from both sides, left United unable to break down a well-organized Everton defense.

Match Overview

  • Final Score: Everton 0, Manchester United 0
  • Standings Impact: Everton moved into sixth place in the league table following their first draw of the campaign, remaining two points behind Manchester United.
  • Key Chances: Everton's Hannah Blundell forced a first-half save from Phallon Tullis-Joyce, while United's best late opening fell to Elisabeth Terland, whose close-range effort was stopped by Everton goalkeeper Courtney Brosnan.

Manager Reaction

Manchester United head coach Eva Olid acknowledged the shortcomings in her team's performance, pointing to a lack of creativity in possession and tardiness in individual duels out of possession. Olid noted that the squad failed to replicate the standards shown in their previous outing against Manchester City.

Everton head coach Scott Phelan praised his side's first-half competitiveness and defensive organization, though he conceded that the team lacked a clinical end product in the final third.

Practical Implications

  • Manchester United failed to capitalize on the chance to secure ground in the upper tier of the WSL standings.
  • Everton extended their defensive resilience under Phelan, securing a point that lifts them above Arsenal pending Sunday's fixtures.

To verify official match details, starting lineups, and league standings, supporters can consult the official Women's Super League website or the club channels of both Manchester United and Everton.
